name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Saute diced onion and bell pepper in butter until soft.
Pour eggs over vegetables, cook until set, fold with cheese inside.

name: Spinach Feta Scramble
instructions: Wilt spinach and garlic in olive oil.
Add beaten eggs, scramble gently.
Fold in crumbled feta and season with salt.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Roll out dough and spread crushed tomato.
Top with mozzarella slices.
Bake at high heat, finish with fresh basil and olive oil.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente.
Gently fry sliced garlic and chili flakes in olive oil.
Toss pasta with the oil, garnish with parsley.

name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Saute onion and mushroom in butter.
Add rice, toast briefly, deglaze with wine.
Add broth gradually, stirring, until creamy. Finish with parmesan.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, then sear.
Simmer onion, garlic, ginger and tomato into a sauce.
Add chicken and cream, simmer until cooked through.

name: Chana Masala
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger with spices.
Add tomato and cook down into a thick sauce.
Add chickpeas and simmer until flavors meld.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Simmer onion, garlic, ginger and tomato into a sauce.
Blend smooth, return to pan with butter and cream.
Add paneer cubes and simmer briefly.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion, cumin and chili powder.
Warm taco shells.
Fill shells with beef, top with tomato, lettuce and cheese.

name: Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Saute onion, then add black beans, cumin and chili powder.
Mash lightly and warm through.
Fill taco shells, top with tomato, lettuce and a squeeze of lime.

name: Classic Guacamole
instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fold in diced onion, tomato and chopped cilantro.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
instructions: Stir-fry chicken until browned.
Add garlic, ginger, chili and bell pepper.
Toss with soy sauce and peanuts, garnish with green onion.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Scramble egg, set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas.
Add cold rice, soy sauce and sesame oil, toss with egg and green onion.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Pan-fry cubed tofu until golden, set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, broccoli and carrot.
Return tofu, toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak rice noodles until pliable.
Stir-fry garlic and shrimp, push aside and scramble egg.
Add noodles, fish sauce and bean sprouts. Toss, top with peanuts and lime.

name: Thai Green Curry
instructions: Fry curry paste in a splash of coconut milk until fragrant.
Add chicken and remaining coconut milk, simmer.
Add bell pepper, finish with basil and fish sauce.

name: Miso Soup
instructions: Bring dashi to a gentle simmer.
Whisk in miso paste off heat.
Add cubed tofu, seaweed and sliced green onion.

name: Salmon Teriyaki
instructions: Simmer soy sauce, mirin, sugar, garlic and ginger into a glaze.
Pan-sear salmon, basting with the glaze.
Serve over steamed rice.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomato and red onion.
Toss with olives and crumbled feta.
Dress with olive oil and oregano.

name: Falafel Wrap
instructions: Blend chickpeas, garlic and spices, form patties, fry until crisp.
Warm flatbread.
Fill with falafel, cucumber, tomato and a drizzle of tahini.

name: Classic Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and garlic until smooth.
Adjust with olive oil and cumin to taste.

name: Classic Beef Burger
instructions: Form and season beef patties, grill to preference.
Toast buns.
Assemble with cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion and ketchup.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter one side of two bread slices.
Fill with cheese, butter-side out.
Grill in a pan until golden and cheese melts.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
instructions: Whisk dry ingredients, then mix in egg and milk.
Cook spoonfuls of batter on a buttered griddle until bubbles form.
Flip and cook until golden.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, milk and yogurt in a jar.
Stir in honey and sliced banana.
Refrigerate overnight.

name: Banana Peanut Butter Smoothie
instructions: Blend banana, peanut butter, milk and honey until smooth.

name: Hearty Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic.
Add lentils, broth and cumin, simmer until lentils are tender.
Blend partially for a thicker texture if desired.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomato and mozzarella.
Layer alternately with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Simmer onion, bell pepper, garlic, tomato and spices into a sauce.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until eggs are set.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir Fry
instructions: Sear sliced beef quickly, set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger and broccoli.
Return beef, toss with soy sauce and sesame oil, serve over rice.

name: Mixed Vegetable Curry
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger with curry powder.
Add potato, cauliflower and tomato, simmer with a splash of water.
Stir in peas at the end and cook until vegetables are tender.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill and slice chicken.
Toss romaine with caesar dressing.
Top with chicken, parmesan and croutons.

name: Veggie Quesadilla
instructions: Saute bell pepper and onion.
Fill tortilla with cheese, vegetables and black beans, fold.
Cook in a pan until cheese melts and tortilla is crisp.

name: Classic French Toast
instructions: Whisk egg, milk and cinnamon.
Dip bread slices, then fry in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Saute mustard seeds, onion and curry leaves in oil until fragrant.
Add boiled potato and turmeric, mash lightly to make the filling.
Spread dosa batter thin on a hot griddle, add the filling, fold and serve crisp.

name: Idli with Sambar
instructions: Steam idli batter in molds until fluffy and set.
Cook toor dal until soft, then add tamarind pulp, tomato and vegetables.
Stir in sambar powder, simmer, then temper with mustard seeds and curry leaves. Serve with the idli.

name: Medu Vada
instructions: Grind soaked urad dal into a thick, fluffy batter.
Fold in chopped onion, green chili, curry leaves and ginger.
Shape into rings and deep fry until golden and crisp.

name: Rava Upma
instructions: Dry roast semolina until fragrant, then set aside.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts, ginger and green chili in oil, add onion and saute.
Add water, bring to a boil, stir in the semolina and cook until fluffy.

name: Ven Pongal
instructions: Cook rice and moong dal together with water until soft and mushy.
Temper black pepper, cumin, ginger, curry leaves and cashew in ghee.
Stir the tempering into the rice-dal mixture and serve hot.

name: Sambar Rice
instructions: Cook rice separately until soft.
Cook toor dal with tamarind, tomato and vegetables, then season with sambar powder.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, mix into the sambar, and serve over rice.

name: Tomato Rasam
instructions: Boil tomato and tamarind pulp with a little cooked toor dal.
Add rasam powder and crushed garlic, simmer until fragrant.
Temper mustard seed, cumin and curry leaves in ghee, and pour over the rasam.

name: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
instructions: Mash cooked rice with yogurt and a splash of milk until creamy.
Temper mustard seeds, curry leaves, green chili and ginger in oil.
Stir the tempering into the curd rice and serve chilled or at room temperature.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
instructions: Cook rice and toor dal together with mixed vegetables until soft.
Add tamarind pulp and bisi bele bath powder, then simmer to thicken.
Finish with a ghee tempering of cashew and curry leaves.

name: Lemon Rice
instructions: Temper mustard seeds, peanuts, curry leaves and green chili in oil.
Add turmeric and cooked rice, and toss to coat evenly.
Squeeze in fresh lemon juice and mix well before serving.

name: Avial
instructions: Boil mixed vegetables with turmeric until just tender.
Grind coconut, cumin and green chili into a coarse paste and stir in.
Finish with yogurt and a drizzle of raw coconut oil, and garnish with curry leaves.

name: Kerala Fish Curry (Meen Curry)
instructions: Simmer tamarind pulp with chili powder, onion, garlic and ginger.
Add fish pieces and cook gently until just done.
Stir in coconut milk, simmer briefly, and temper with mustard seed and curry leaves in coconut oil.

name: Chicken Chettinad
instructions: Roast coconut, black pepper and fennel seed, then grind into a paste.
Saute onion, garlic, ginger and curry leaves in coconut oil, add tomato and cook down.
Add chicken and the ground paste, and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.

name: Pesarattu
instructions: Grind soaked moong dal with ginger, green chili and cumin into a smooth batter.
Spread thin on a hot griddle like a dosa, and sprinkle chopped onion on top.
Drizzle oil, cook until crisp on both sides and serve hot.

name: Semiya Payasam
instructions: Roast vermicelli lightly in ghee along with cashew and raisin.
Add milk and sugar, and simmer until the vermicelli is soft and the payasam thickens.
Finish with a pinch of cardamom and serve warm or chilled.

name: Kerala Vegetable Stew (Ishtu)
instructions: Saute onion, ginger, green chili and curry leaves in coconut oil.
Add potato, carrot and beans with a little water, and simmer until tender.
Stir in coconut milk and black pepper, simmer gently without a hard boil, and serve warm.
